dispositions.topic_text: Kernel–trace-store boundary and responsibility for classifying refusal and stopping execution
dispositions.reason: Answered by 30_modules.md: the calling module writes through store and returns the stop; surface answers every store failure internal_error and alone ends the process (A14 rules 5 and 7, A16 rule 7)

dispositions.topic_text: Scope of what stops after trace-record refusal
dispositions.reason: Answered by 30_modules.md: a refused trace write is a store failure answered internal_error, after which surface ends the whole kernel process, not an attempt, node or run
